Six astuces neuves, aucune dans cs-o002, cs-o004 ni donnees/label.json : commencer l'épreuve par la question la plus sûre, se retester 3 jours plus tard (place micabo, slide 3), la matière la plus dure à son meilleur moment, surligner après avoir lu, se déconnecter des réseaux sur l'ordinateur (place UnSwipe, slide 6), écrire ses inquiétudes avant l'épreuve. Aucun chiffre ni « studies show ». Images jamais prises par nos originaux, sans visage ; slides 3 et 6 sans personne. Écartée à l'aperçu : 325104bd (logo de marque sur une tasse).

study hacks i wish i knew earlier
(exam edition)

on the test, read every question first and start with the one you're surest about.
easy points first = less panic.

test yourself again 3 days later, not just right after studying.
if you still know it then, it's actually learned.

put your hardest subject at the time of day you focus best.
not at 10pm when you're already tired.

highlight AFTER you finish a section, not while you read it.
otherwise the whole page ends up yellow.

log out of social media on your laptop.
if getting back in takes effort, you won't open it on autopilot.

nervous before a test? take a few minutes to write down what worries you.
it gets it out of your head and onto the paper.
try these now and thank me later
